hero.headline1: Good gut health... has a helper

cards.title: Easy to take
cards.subtitle: Dissolves in your mouth
cards.description: The power of Fine granules format creates micro probiotic beads that dissolve easily without sticking in your throat. Plus, special 5-layer Encapsulation technology protects probiotic value all the way to your gut.

cards.title: BC 198
cards.subtitle: Tiny beads, packed in one sachet
cards.description: Quality microorganisms that withstand heat and acid. Bacillus coagulans BC198 is research-backed for producing SCFAs (short-chain fatty acids) up to 8x higher than normal, effectively benefiting your gut.

cards.title: Great taste
cards.subtitle: Loved by Thai palates
cards.description: Bursting with delicious pineapple powder that's refreshing and suits Thai palates. Pineapple also contains Bromelain enzyme that helps reduce bloating and improves digestion.
